description: Comment "Fix" and I'll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to fix your entire life in one day? I tried this and it literally knocked out stuff I've been avoiding for two years in a single afternoon. Prompt 1: Go to ChatGPT, choose Work at the top, then say: "Interview me about everything in my life that's broken, unfinished, or quietly stressing me out, and turn all of it into one list." Turn on voice to text and answer everything. ChatGPT hands you the full list of everything that's been sitting on your shoulders. Prompt 2: "Now turn this into a one-day plan and put the things that get fixed the fastest at the top." Now your entire life is organized into one single day. Prompt 3 (the trick): "Now handle everything on that list that doesn't need me." ChatGPT starts knocking things out right in front of you—canceling subscriptions you forgot about, drafting emails and texts you've been avoiding, booking appointments you keep putting off, checking them off one by one while you watch. Bonus prompt: "Now tell me one thing on this list that would change my life the most if I actually did it today." The answer usually hits harder than most people expect. #chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #productivity #selfimprovement
